attempts.plan: The current TransactionManager is a monolithic class exceeding size and method limits. It uses static fields causing tight coupling and fails the escape tests. We split it into focused classes: State (holds all data), AccountManager (account ops), TransactionProcessor (dispatch and validation), TransferHandler/WithdrawHandler/DepositHandler/ReverseHandler (action-specific logic), ConversionEngine, LimitManager, FeeManager, ReportBuilder, and LogManager for audit/counts. We keep the facade TransactionManager implementing Ledger that delegates to these components. This preserves exact behavior while meeting file count, line length, and method size constraints. The legacy TransactionManager is removed, and RustyLedger is updated to return a new TransactionManager instance.
